recognize_zh: 低倍 H&E 淋巴組織中有數個結節狀區域，被周圍小淋巴球包覆；核染色的免疫染色只在其中兩個結節呈幾乎全部細胞核強陽性，其他結節與背景僅散在陽性，提示濾泡內（被「包覆」的）高增生性病灶，如 Burkitt 淋巴瘤。此放大倍率下星空樣（starry sky）巨噬細胞無法清楚辨認。
features: Low-power lymphoid tissue with multiple vague nodules separated by sheets of small lymphocytes
Nodules composed of densely packed cells; tingible-body macrophages suggested as scattered pale spots but not resolvable at this magnification
Nuclear immunostain (likely Ki-67 or MYC; not labeled) with near-100% strong nuclear positivity confined to two well-circumscribed nodules
Other nodules and interfollicular areas show only scattered positive nuclei
Sharp demarcation between positive nodules and surrounding negative lymphoid cells (mantle-like cuff)
describe_en: Low-power H&E section shows lymphoid tissue with multiple ill-defined nodules surrounded by small lymphocytes, without obvious diffuse effacement at this magnification. A nuclear immunostain highlights two sharply circumscribed nodules with near-uniform strong nuclear positivity, whereas the remaining nodules and interfollicular regions show only scattered positive nuclei. The starry-sky pattern cannot be assessed at this resolution, and the antibody is not labeled; high-power morphology, MYC FISH and a complete B-cell phenotype (CD10, BCL6, BCL2 negative) are required. In the stated context, findings are suggestive of Burkitt lymphoma with a follicular/nodular (in situ-like) distribution cloaked within otherwise preserved lymphoid tissue.

ddx.vs: Reactive germinal centers show polarized, moderate-to-high Ki-67 with tingible-body macrophages in all follicles and are BCL2 negative without MYC rearrangement, rather than near-100% staining restricted to select nodules.
Neoplastic follicles are usually BCL2 positive, back-to-back and show lower, non-polarized proliferation with BCL2 rearrangement.

ddx.dx: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements
ddx.vs: Morphology may overlap; FISH demonstrating concurrent BCL2 rearrangement discriminates it from Burkitt lymphoma.
DLBCL cells are larger and more pleomorphic with variable Ki-67 and usually lack the IG::MYC translocation as the sole driver.

stain: H&E; IHC: nuclear marker (likely Ki-67, not labeled)
